routes.when: Small, localized changes: typo fixes, single-file edits, adding a unit test, explaining a short code snippet, or formatting and comment-only updates where speed matters more than deep reasoning.

Everyday feature work in one or two modules: implement an API endpoint, fix a regression with a clear stack trace, write integration tests, or refactor a class without changing system-wide architecture.

Multi-step problems that need visible reasoning: design a data model and migration plan, compare two implementation approaches with tradeoffs, debug intermittent failures from logs, or plan a feature before coding.
Large or cross-cutting code changes: refactor across many packages, reconcile conflicting patterns, performance work that touches hot paths, or subtle bugs that span services, configs, and tests.

Highest-complexity work: greenfield system architecture, security-sensitive flows, distributed-system failure modes, or open-ended research where the agent must explore alternatives before committing to a design.
